label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Patrick Reed Returns
items.text: Patrick Reed is competing at the Spanish Open after recovering from an injury suffered at Wentworth, leading a strong field in Madrid.

items.headline: Jon Rahm Quits LIV Golf
items.text: Jon Rahm announced he is leaving LIV Golf after three years, also skipping the Spanish Open to await the birth of his fourth child.

items.headline: Tiger Woods' Future Uncertain
items.text: Tiger Woods continues to face physical challenges limiting his play, with his competitive golf future remaining unclear.
